defmodule Ledger.Billing.Invoice do
  use Ash.Resource, otp_app: :ledger, domain: Ledger.Billing, data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets

  ets do
    private? true
  end

  actions do
    default_read :*
    default_destroy :*
    
    create :issue do
      argument :reference, :string, allow_nil?: false
      argument :subtotal, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
      argument :adjustments, {:array, Ledger.Money.Type}, default: []
      argument :credit_limit, Ledger.Money.Usd
      change set_attribute(:reference, arg(:reference))
      change set_attribute(:subtotal, arg(:subtotal))
      change set_attribute(:adjustments, arg(:adjustments))
      change set_attribute(:credit_limit, arg(:credit_limit))
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        subtotal = changeset.attributes.subtotal
        Enum.reduce(changeset.attributes.adjustments, changeset, fn adj, cs ->
          if adj.currency != subtotal.currency do
            Ash.Changeset.add_error(cs, field: :adjustments, message: "must all use the currency of the subtotal")
          else
            cs
          end
        end)
      end
    end

    update :apply_adjustment do
      argument :adjustment, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        subtotal = changeset.data.subtotal
        adj = changeset.arguments.adjustment
        if adj.currency != subtotal.currency do
          Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, field: :adjustment, message: "must use the currency of the subtotal")
        else
          Ash.Changeset.change_attribute(changeset, :adjustments, changeset.data.adjustments ++ [adj])
        end
      end
    end

    generic action :price_for, Ledger.Money.Type do
      argument :unit_price, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
      argument :units, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      run fn input, _ -> Ledger.Money.multiply(input.arguments.unit_price, input.arguments.units) end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :reference, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :subtotal, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false, constraints: [currencies: [:usd, :eur, :jpy]]
    attribute :adjustments, {:array, Ledger.Money.Type}, default: []
    attribute :credit_limit, Ledger.Money.Usd
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :payments, Ledger.Billing.Payment
  end

  aggregates do
    aggregate :paid_minor, :payments, :amount_minor, kind: :sum, default: 0
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :total, Ledger.Money.Type, expr(subtotal + adjustments)
    calculate :balance, Ledger.Money.Type, expr(total - paid_minor)
  end
end
